soundness_flags.label: Definitions of A, E and Theorems 2–6
soundness_flags.one_line: Because P_n permits the mask Omega to vary, the displayed infimum over a single f:R^{|Omega|}->R is not defined uniformly over P_n; fix a design sequence or optimize over a measurable design-indexed family of statistics.

soundness_flags.label: Definitions def:feasible-score and def:variance-calibration; Theorems 3 and 6
soundness_flags.one_line: Fhat, Chat, khat, guarded predecessor regressions, pilot sufficient statistics, and the band-selection criterion are described procedurally but not defined as mathematical maps, so the expansion and Wald interval do not yet name a determinate statistic.

soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-rank-index
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Chernozhukov–Hansen–Liao–Zhu result is formulated for spiked low-rank matrices whose rank grows slowly relative to dimension, so it does not support the claimed fixed-rank condition under that citation.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article constructs asymptotically normal estimators for general linear forms using double-sample debiasing and low-rank projection under noisy matrix completion.
The paper gives rate-optimal ATE recovery for general intervention patterns, uses tangent-space geometry, and assumes independent mean-zero sub-Gaussian entry noise.
The paper studies approximate spiked low-rank matrices, defining them to have rank growing slowly relative to their dimensions, and gives semiparametrically efficient inference.
The article develops inference for matrix completion when missing is not at random, divides missing entries into groups, and obtains asymptotic normality after debiasing under its stated conditions.
The article establishes asymptotic normality for low-rank completion without sample splitting and uses an auxiliary leave-one-out estimator in its technical argument.
The article studies low-rank-plus-sparse recovery under arbitrary entrywise dependence and proves deterministic lower bounds and matching minimax global recovery risks.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the experiment common-domain: condition P_n on a fixed (N,T,Omega) sequence, or define f as a measurable family f_{N,T,Omega}; then rewrite A_n and E_n with that domain explicitly.

Replace the prose-only same-panel construction with explicit pilot maps, predecessor-regression objectives, cross-fit indices, clipping rule, conditional-projection formula, and a deterministic tie-breaking band selector; define Chat, khat, Fhat, and shat from those maps.

Retag fixed rank with a citation actually imposing fixed rank, or weaken the claim to the slowly-growing spiked-rank regime supported by Chernozhukov et al.; inspect the JASA version of Zhang–Shen–Kong before retaining inverse-Cholesky-tail attribution.

Add a worked finite Ferrers instance that computes k, b_q, both derivative terms, Delta_P, and the two published-procedure normalizations, so the frontier is exhibited from observable primitives rather than only specified abstractly.

recommended_next_step: Revise the statistical domain and fully define the feasible maps, then re-review the repaired field-tier frontier and its covariance-assumption sourcing.
